records.rationale: A clear real-world use of range-add frequency counting,followed by independent per-edge cost choices.
Good interval-DP practice on a circle with one deterministic greedy opponent;clarifies whose turn belongs in a state.
Combines single-source shortest paths with a threshold sweep over costs;useful practice beyond returning one distance array.
Interesting threshold reasoning through repeated median-like elimination,but the unusual queue process makes it specialized enrichment.
A friendly partition-DP exercise:extend the last box while updating its minimum and maximum.
Teaches prefix/suffix subsequence counts and separating the contribution of one inserted character.
Uses the original shortest-path layers to reason about monotone fare changes;valuable after BFS and offline processing.
Develops translation invariants for an extremely long repeated walk;specialized geometry enrichment rather than core simulation.
An excellent example where a range update changes only two adjacent differences;strong preparation for more complex range problems.
Teaches allocation by marginal gains across independent line segments with a very large implicit coordinate range.
A good advanced decision-problem transformation with monotone grid boundaries and symmetry handling.
Teaches expanded shortest-path states by separating carrying,motion and kicking modes instead of tracking every player configuration.
A clean introductory greedy problem:decide which idle gaps are worth separating with a limited number of activations.
Turns a subset objective with a size-range penalty into a sorted interval and running best prefix expression.
Shows how an apparently two-dimensional packing conflict can be decomposed into narrow dependencies for DP.
A useful advanced subset-transform problem that rewards choosing among complementary query representations.
Accessible grid counting with independent row/column choices;good practice replacing nested enumeration with suffix counts.
Practices matching ordered resources to items while respecting two monotone criteria;useful after simpler frame/item greedy tasks.
Connects stable ordering of equal symbols,adjacent-swap cost and count-based sequence-building DP.
Offers advanced tree-distance uniqueness and distinct-color aggregation;useful enrichment after standard rerooting and diameter work.
